players.product: Specialty (meth)acrylate monomers used as raw materials for ArF and EUV photoresists (Electronic Materials segment, semiconductor materials group)

quarterly_data.signal: Revised consolidated forecast for the fiscal year ending November 30, 2026 (announced 10-09-2026, replacing the July 2, 2026 forecast): net sales JPY 42,500 million (previous JPY 39,000 million; +9.0%), operating profit JPY 9,300 million (previous JPY 7,500 million; +24.0%), ordinary profit JPY 9,600 million (previous JPY 7,700 million), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 6,600 million (previous JPY 5,200 million). Reason given: sales of semiconductor materials, primarily for ArF resists, remained strong and electronic-materials sales increased, while high-purity special solvents at subsidiaries remained strong; with growing demand and progress in passing through cost increases arising from the deteriorating Middle East situation, profits are expected to significantly exceed the previous forecast.
quarterly_data.figure: Fiscal year to November 2026: net sales JPY 42,500 million (from JPY 39,000 million); operating profit JPY 9,300 million (from JPY 7,500 million)
